Full-depth fan-out: family "Distributed default ground — governance and ProjectCentral starters". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Moves: the distributed defaults — the day closes (settle: the boundary that makes NOW useful), session work has a place (gather: work placed, not scattered), one wiki per register holds (returns between registers — the law holds), repo content and structure hold, the root NOW field emerges, the projectcentral defaults echo hold/gather, and Telos emerges — open intent.

3D: the member's depth is continuity layers — z is Central's own depth relation: the living surface nearest, the carried ground deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=sources hold their standing, gather=continuity gathers the field (Central holds by attraction), vortex=correction turns the ground, rupture=recovery from loss, settle=continuity at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the carried ground breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words.
